# DensityScope

Header: `winui/ui/containers/DensityScope.hpp`. Spec: `winui/ui/containers/DensityScope.hpp`.

A wrapper that measures and draws its one child at compact or standard control density, which applies the compact sizing to one subtree.

The child sees a copy of the theme whose `sizing` is [Theme::ControlSizing::compact()](../themes/theme.md#compact). [TextBox](../controls/text-box.md#uitextbox), the controls built on it and [ComboBox](../controls/combo-box.md#uicombobox) shrink, and everything else keeps its size. Density::Standard passes the theme through unchanged. Popups opened from inside the scope are drawn in the window's own theme, at standard density. Input, focus and ticks pass through to the child.

Example: 
```cpp
// Declarative: a compact form, switchable at run time through a Property.
ui::Property<ui::Density> density{ui::Density::Compact};
window.set_content(ui::DensityScope{
    .density = density,
    .content = ui::VerticalStack{
        .spacing  = 8,
        .content  = {
            ui::TextBox{.header = "Name"},
            ui::ComboBox{.items = {"Red", "Green", "Blue"}},
        },
    },
});

// Imperative: the scope owns its child through ContentHost::set_child().
auto scope = std::make_unique<ui::DensityScopeControl>(ui::Density::Compact);
ui::TextBoxControl* box = scope->set_child(std::make_unique<ui::TextBoxControl>());
const ui::Theme& inside = scope->scoped(ui::Theme::default_light());
// inside.sizing.text_control_min_height == 24, down from 32
```

## `ui::DensityScope`

Shows its child at compact or standard control density, which applies the compact control sizes to a whole subtree. Builds a [ui::DensityScopeControl](#uidensityscopecontrol).

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<bool> compact{true};

window.set_content(ui::DensityScope{
    .density = ui::bind(compact, [](bool c) { return c ? ui::Density::Compact : ui::Density::Standard; }),
    .content = ui::VerticalStack{.spacing = 8, .content = {
        ui::TextBox{.placeholder_text = "Name"},
        ui::ComboBox{.items = {"One", "Two"}},
        ui::Button{.text = "Submit"},
    }},
});
```

Every field, in the order a designated initializer names them:

```cpp
ui::DensityScope{
    .density, .style, .margin, .width, .height, .min_width, .min_height, .max_width,
    .max_height, .horizontal_alignment, .vertical_alignment, .visible, .tool_tip,
    .accessibility, .on_pointer_entered, .on_pointer_exited, .on_got_focus, .on_lost_focus,
    .on_key_down, .on_wheel, .control, .content
}
```

Fields, in declaration order (designators must follow it):

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <span id="uidensityscope-density"></span>`density` | `ui::Binding<ui::Density>` | `{ui::Density::Compact}` | Compact, the default, shrinks control heights and paddings. Standard changes nothing. |
| <span id="uidensityscope-on_pointer_entered"></span>`on_pointer_entered` | `ui::Action` |  | The pointer moved onto the control. |
| <span id="uidensityscope-on_pointer_exited"></span>`on_pointer_exited` | `ui::Action` |  | The pointer left the control. |
| <span id="uidensityscope-on_got_focus"></span>`on_got_focus` | `ui::Action` |  | Keyboard focus arrived on the control, or on anything inside it, from outside it. A control with nothing focusable in it never gets focus, and never raises this. |
| <span id="uidensityscope-on_lost_focus"></span>`on_lost_focus` | `ui::Action` |  | Keyboard focus left the control and everything inside it. |
| <span id="uidensityscope-on_key_down"></span>`on_key_down` | `ui::Callback<ui::Handling(const ui::KeyEvent&)>` |  | A key pressed while focus is on the control or inside it, before the control's own handling; [ui::Handled](../core/namespace-ui.md#handled) stops it there ([Element::on_key_down()](../tree/element.md#on_key_down)). |
| <span id="uidensityscope-on_wheel"></span>`on_wheel` | `ui::Callback<ui::Handling(const ui::PointerEvent&)>` |  | A wheel turn over the control, before the control scrolls; [ui::Handled](../core/namespace-ui.md#handled) stops it there ([Element::on_wheel()](../tree/element.md#on_wheel)). |
| <span id="uidensityscope-control"></span>`control` | `ui::ControlOut<ui::DensityScope>` |  | Out: the handle that receives the built control. |
| <span id="uidensityscope-content"></span>`content` | `ui::Spec` |  | The subtree the density applies to. |

Plus the common fields `style`, `margin`, `width`, `height`, `min_width`, `min_height`, `max_width`, `max_height`, `horizontal_alignment`, `vertical_alignment`, `visible`, `tool_tip`, `accessibility` every spec carries ([conventions](../conventions.md#common-fields-on-every-spec)).

### build

```cpp
std::unique_ptr<Element> build()&&
```

Consumes the spec and returns the built [ui::DensityScopeControl](#uidensityscopecontrol); the caller owns it.

The child sees a copy of the theme whose `sizing` is [Theme::ControlSizing::compact()](../themes/theme.md#compact). ### DensityScopeControl

```cpp
DensityScopeControl() = default
```

A compact scope with no child yet.

### DensityScopeControl

```cpp
DensityScopeControl(Density density)
```

A scope at [`density`](#density), with no child yet.

### density

```cpp
Density density() const
```

The density applied to the child. Density::Compact by default.

### set_density

```cpp
void set_density(Density density)
```

Changes the density. Updates layout and redraws, since every control underneath measures again against the new sizing.

### scoped

```cpp
const Theme& scoped(const Theme& base) const
```

The theme the subtree sees. At Density::Standard that is `base` itself, otherwise a copy of it at compact density, kept in the scope and valid until the next call.

### scoped

```cpp
const Theme& scoped(const Theme&& base) const = delete
```

Deleted, since at Density::Standard the result is `base` itself, which a temporary would leave dangling.

### measure_override

```cpp
Size measure_override(Size available, const MeasureContext& context) const override
```

Measures the child against scoped(theme).

### render_override

```cpp
void render_override(Renderer& renderer, const RenderContext& context) const override
```

Draws the child against scoped(theme).

## Enumerations

### Density

```cpp
enum class Density
```

The density a [DensityScope](#uidensityscope) applies.

| Value | |
| --- | --- |
| `Standard` | The theme's own control sizing. The scope changes nothing. |
| `Compact` | [Theme::ControlSizing::compact()](../themes/theme.md#compact), with smaller minimum heights and paddings. |
